name: The Nation cryptic crossword No 3469
preamble: Puzzled? No more cross words! Read Kosman and Picciotto on “Solving The Nation’s Cryptic Puzzles.” Or watch this video.

clue.text: Nonetheless, bring back Congressman Hoyer to worry about large devices for capturing flashes of color?

definitions.text: devices for capturing flashes of color

indicators.note: to bring something back is to return it the way it came, so the string that follows is read from its end

blocks.note: nonetheless means 'but', 'even so'
Steny Hoyer is a long-serving Maryland congressman
L is the clothing-size abbreviation for large
to fret is to worry

explanation.surface: Despite everything, a politician is pestered about the large gear needed for some colorful hunt.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bring back' covers everything up to 'large', with 'worry about large' setting the L just ahead of FRET once reversed. 'Flashes of color' is a playful way to describe butterflies.
explanation.definitionFit: Butterflies are the flashes of color, and a fine mesh net on a pole is the collector's tool for catching them.

clue.text: White South African protects woman in arbor

indicators.note: to protect is to shield by surrounding, so one piece wraps around another

blocks.note: a Boer is an Afrikaner, a white South African of Dutch descent
W is the abbreviation for woman

explanation.surface: An Afrikaner farmer shields a woman sitting in a garden shelter.
explanation.definitionFit: A bower is a leafy shelter in a garden, the same thing as an arbor.

clue.text: At first, Tupac MC'd in a corner

indicators.note: 'at first' asks for only the opening letter of the next word

blocks.note: the initial of the rapper's name
to MC is to rap over a hip-hop track

explanation.surface: Early on, the rapper Tupac Shakur performed from a corner of the stage.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone trapped has no way out, which is what being in a corner means figuratively.

clue.text: What comes across heroic, if Fox Entertainment backs away by virtue of one's position

indicators.note: what comes across spanning several words is a run of letters lying over them
backing away is moving in reverse, so the letters are read from right to left

blocks.note: a run of letters spanning these words

explanation.surface: A TV network retreats from a heroic image, as its standing requires.
explanation.walkthrough: Fox Entertainment is the US TV network; only its letters matter.
explanation.definitionFit: Ex officio is Latin for 'from the office', describing a role held automatically because of another post.

clue.text: Understand corpulent Spanish man halfway

indicators.note: halfway means stopping at the middle, so only the first half of the word is kept

blocks.note: corpulent means fat
the first half of hombre, Spanish for man

explanation.surface: Trying to make sense of a stout Spaniard partway through.
explanation.definitionFit: To fathom something is to get to the bottom of it, i.e. comprehend it.

clue.text: Some evergreen growth definitely has to be in France, bearing weight

indicators.note: to have something is to hold it, so one piece keeps another within it
bearing means carrying, so a piece holds another inside it

blocks.note: an emphatic 'definitely!' is a yes
être is French for 'to be'
W is the abbreviation for weight

explanation.surface: A gardener insists that conifers really must exist in France, however heavy.
explanation.walkthrough: Two containers nest: 'bearing' acts on the French verb, and 'has' then puts that result inside the word for definitely.
explanation.definitionFit: Yew trees are conifers that keep their dark needles all year, so a stand of them is evergreen growth.

clue.text: Discharges, second time around

indicators.note: turning around means facing the other way, so the word is read backwards

blocks.note: S is the abbreviation for second
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone is let go from a job for the second time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Discharges' suggests firing or releasing people; here it means giving off.
explanation.definitionFit: To emit is to send out or give off, as a chimney discharges smoke.

clue.text: Colleagues ultimately choose to accept the man's a specious reasoner

indicators.note: ultimately points to the end, so only the closing letter of the word is kept
accepting something is taking it in, so one piece goes inside the other

blocks.note: the final letter of colleagues
to opt is to choose
the possessive pronoun for something belonging to a man

explanation.surface: Coworkers end up taking on a man who argues with slippery logic.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the man's' reads as 'the man is', but it is the possessive.
explanation.definitionFit: A sophist uses clever but misleading arguments, which is exactly a reasoner whose logic is plausible yet false.

clue.text: Loud newspaper tirade that comes out smelling like a rose

blocks.note: F is forte, the musical direction for loud
a rag is a disparaging word for a newspaper
a rant is a long angry tirade

explanation.surface: A tabloid's noisy attack ends up leaving its target looking good.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Comes out smelling like a rose' is an idiom for emerging unscathed; here it is taken literally.
explanation.definitionFit: Fragrant means sweet-scented, which is what something smelling like a rose literally is.

clue.text: Exhaust our team before a defeat

blocks.note: our side, the team we are on, is 'we'
taken as written
a rout is a crushing defeat

explanation.surface: A coach laments the team running out of energy just ahead of a beating.
explanation.definitionFit: To wear out someone is to tire them completely, a phrasal-verb synonym for exhaust.

clue.text: An urge for every moan

blocks.note: a whim is a sudden urge
per means 'for each', as in 'a dollar per person'

explanation.surface: A grumbler who has a complaint ready for every passing impulse.
explanation.definitionFit: A whimper is a low plaintive cry, close in sense to a moan; both work as nouns or verbs.

clue.text: Compensated agent with help

blocks.note: a rep, short for representative, is a sales agent
aid means help

explanation.surface: A paid agent who comes along with assistants.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer spans two lights: REP at 11 and AID at 24.
explanation.definitionFit: To be repaid is to be compensated, given back money or reward for what one spent or did.

clue.text: Healthy beauties in Paradise, head to toe in brief romance

indicators.note: the top of the word is sent to its foot, so the opening letter moves to the end
one part is set inside another, which wraps around it

blocks.note: a fling is a short-lived affair
houris are the beautiful maidens of the Islamic paradise

explanation.surface: Attractive fit folk enjoying a short holiday romance somewhere idyllic.
explanation.walkthrough: Houris are the maidens promised to the faithful in the Islamic paradise; 'head to toe' sends the first letter to the end before the insertion.
explanation.definitionFit: Something flourishing is thriving and vigorous, so it is a synonym of healthy in the sense of doing well.

clue.text: Summons editor inside to dress up

indicators.note: one element is put within the other, which encloses it

blocks.note: a beck is a summoning gesture, as in 'at someone's beck and call'
ED is the standard abbreviation for editor

explanation.surface: An editor is called in to smarten up a publication.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Summons' looks like a verb but is a noun: BECK, a call or gesture.
explanation.definitionFit: To bedeck is to adorn or decorate, which is what dressing up a room or person means.

clue.text: Eastern European snake eats half-slice of nectarine

indicators.note: something eaten ends up inside the eater, so one piece goes within the other
a slice is one small piece, here the opening letter of the word

blocks.note: a boa is a constricting snake
hemi- is the prefix meaning half, as in hemisphere
the opening letter of nectarine

explanation.surface: A snake from Eastern Europe swallows a sliver of fruit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'half-slice' splits in two: 'half' is the Greek-derived prefix, which the snake swallows, and the slice of nectarine is added after.
explanation.definitionFit: A Bohemian comes from Bohemia, the western region of the Czech Republic, so is an Eastern European.

clue.text: Sell James a blood feud

blocks.note: to vend is to sell
Etta James was an American soul and blues singer

explanation.surface: A rivalry so bitter that one man would sell out James.
explanation.walkthrough: 'James' looks like a man's first name; it stands for Etta James, the singer of 'At Last'.
explanation.definitionFit: A vendetta is a long-running family quarrel marked by revenge killings, the classic blood feud.

clue.text: Doctor Oakland squad, maintaining elegance in driving contests

indicators.note: to maintain is to hold, so one piece keeps another inside it

blocks.note: DR is the abbreviation for doctor
the Oakland A's (Athletics) are a baseball team
grace means elegance

explanation.surface: A team physician keeps things stylish at motor-racing events.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Doctor' looks like an anagram signal but simply gives DR.
explanation.definitionFit: Drag races are sprints between two cars from a standing start, contests decided by driving.

clue.text: What the NSA collects from you and me (fanfare imitation): thanks

definitions.text: What the NSA collects from you

blocks.note: taken as written
'ta-da!' imitates a trumpet fanfare
ta is informal British for thanks

explanation.surface: Mocking mass surveillance: the spies collect our data, play a fanfare and say thank you.
explanation.walkthrough: 'you and me' looks like one phrase, but the definition stops at 'you'.
explanation.definitionFit: Metadata is data about communications, such as who called whom and when, which the US National Security Agency gathers in bulk.

clue.text: Fashionable dice for parts of a joint support group?

definitions.text: parts of a joint support group?

blocks.note: hip means trendy, fashionable
bones is old slang for dice, once carved from bone

explanation.surface: Trendy gaming dice handed out at a meeting of fellow cannabis smokers.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition plays on 'joint': not a reefer and a support group, but the hip joint, which these bones hold up.
explanation.definitionFit: The hip bones form the pelvis, the structure that makes up and bears the weight at the hip joint.

clue.text: In bar, order tall part of a beer can

indicators.note: putting things in order rearranges them, so the letters are sorted anew
one piece goes inside the other

blocks.note: a pub is a bar
the letters of tall, rearranged

explanation.surface: At a tavern, you ask for a tall can of beer.
explanation.definitionFit: A pull tab is the ring lever on top of a drinks can that you lift to open it.

clue.text: Living symbol seen in mother's bed

blocks.note: Ma is mother, so mother's is Ma's
a cot is a small or folding bed

explanation.surface: Some lucky emblem turns up in Mom's bed.
explanation.definitionFit: A mascot is a person or animal adopted as the emblem of a team, so a symbol that is alive.

clue.text: Mansion caretaker's beginning to despise gold

indicators.note: a beginning is the start, so only the opening letter is kept

blocks.note: the opening letter of caretaker
to despise is to hate
Au is the chemical symbol for gold

explanation.surface: The custodian of a grand house starts to loathe its riches.
explanation.definitionFit: A château is a French country house or castle, a grand residence like a mansion.

clue.text: Thick hose doesn't begin to hold a bit of heat

indicators.note: not beginning means the word loses its opening letter
holding something keeps it within, so one piece goes inside another

blocks.note: taken as written, before its first letter goes
a BTU, British thermal unit, is a measured amount of heat

explanation.surface: A heavy-duty hose that won't start carrying hot water.
explanation.walkthrough: A BTU is the heat needed to warm a pound of water by one degree Fahrenheit, still used for US heaters and air conditioners.
explanation.definitionFit: Obtuse means slow-witted, so it is a synonym of thick in the sense of dim.

clue.text: Sweet song associated with Frank Sinatra, except involving class

indicators.note: to involve is to take in or enfold, so one piece is wrapped around the other

blocks.note: 'My Way' is Sinatra's signature song
ilk means kind or class
bar means except, as in 'bar none'

explanation.surface: A tender Sinatra number, though one with a touch of class.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sweet' reads as describing the song; it is the definition, meaning a candy, as in the British word for one.
explanation.definitionFit: A Milky Way bar is a chocolate-covered candy bar, and a candy is a sweet.

clue.text: Meditative soldier in playful upset

indicators.note: one piece sits within the other
upset means turned over, which in a down clue flips the word's order

blocks.note: coy means teasingly playful
a GI is an American soldier

explanation.surface: A calm, reflective soldier caught in a lighthearted squabble.
explanation.definitionFit: Yogic describes yoga, the discipline of breathing and meditation, so it fits a meditative practice.

clue.text: See 11
For example, do away with uplifting and sad musical work

indicators.note: lifting up in a down clue moves the bottom to the top, so the letters are read backwards

blocks.note: e.g. abbreviates exempli gratia, for example
to rid is to do away with

explanation.surface: A suggestion to drop cheerful pieces and keep only gloomy ones.
explanation.walkthrough: 'uplifting' looks like the opposite of sad; it is the reversal signal.
explanation.definitionFit: A dirge is a mournful song or lament, as played at a funeral.

clue.text: Island smuggled in giant iguana

indicators.note: smuggled goods are tucked away inside other cargo, so the letters are concealed within the words that follow

blocks.note: a run of letters spanning the two words

explanation.surface: A huge lizard is sneaked onto an island by contraband traders.
explanation.definitionFit: Antigua is a Caribbean island, half of the nation of Antigua and Barbuda.

clue.text: After transport of uranium to the front, one kind of power is incomprehensible

indicators.note: transporting something carries it to a new place, so a letter is shifted within the word
this names where the shifted letter lands: at the very start

blocks.note: U is the chemical symbol for uranium
nuclear power, from atomic fission

explanation.surface: Talk of shipping uranium for atomic energy leaves the public baffled.
explanation.walkthrough: The U of NUCLEAR moves to the front.
explanation.definitionFit: Unclear means not easily understood, a plain synonym of incomprehensible.

clue.text: Ha — clues became cryptic, which is what you get by stirring together elements from three Across entries

definitions.text: what you get by stirring together elements from three Across entries

indicators.note: something cryptic is obscure and puzzling, so the preceding letters are disguised by jumbling

blocks.note: the letters of these three words, punctuation ignored

explanation.surface: A setter laughs that the clues have turned devious.
explanation.walkthrough: 'became' looks like the verb of the sentence but is part of the fodder. The three Across entries begin BUTTER, FLOUR and MILK, the ingredients of the sauce.
explanation.definitionFit: Béchamel is the white sauce made by cooking butter with flour and then whisking in milk.
